【原视频简介】
White Castle has been serving its famous tiny sliders for generations.

French fries turn ordinary potatoes into billions of crispy golden strips, while Mushroom Bites transform simple mushrooms into crunchy, bite-sized snacks.

They look like familiar fast-food favorites, but behind them are surprisingly precise production systems designed for speed, consistency, and flavor.

So how are White Castle sliders, French fries, and Mushroom Bites actually made?

Let’s step inside and find out.
